The '''Sinsang system''' was located in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]], a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Veragi Trade Route/Legends|Veragi Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Anx Minor system/Legends|Anx Minor]] and [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Sinsang]].<ref name="Gamer7" /> Between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Sinsang system was situated within the [[Pentastar Alignment]]'s boundaries.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sinsang system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-4.<ref name="TEA" />
